title: 第13章 至阳至刚万邪辟易第14章 定个小目标
slug: 精灵族的修仙者第342章巢穴
content_zh:
“所以你把他们骗到千岩丘陵，是为了让他们充当亡化仪式的耗材吧。”
安东没有继续和卡修斯争辩，而是轻描淡写地戳破了另一层窗户纸。
“......看来你真的很了解我们组织。”
卡修斯看向安东的眼神变了变，忌惮中混杂着惊疑。
连作为组织核心隐秘的亡化仪式都知道，要不是在安东身上感应不到信物的存在，他几乎都以为对方也是组织的人了。
另一边，随着卡修斯话音落下，哈维四人豁然起身，齐齐抓起武器，神色惊怒地瞪视向卡修斯。
“难怪你提出的报酬那么丰厚，原来是图谋不轨！”
“卑鄙的家伙！”
“贪婪是生命的原罪，是灵魂的污秽。”卡修斯目光冷漠地扫过四人，语调平板如在宣读判决书，“不用担心，很快你们就会得到净化，以死亡之名，归于永恒的宁静。”
“净化你妈！”
队伍里一个叫做史塔的暴脾气青年再也忍不住，举起手中短斧朝卡修斯当头狠狠劈落。
然而斧刃在距离卡修斯头顶还有十余公分的地方，被一层淡淡的微光挡了下来。
安东目光落在卡修斯的胸口处，那枚灰色石坠正绽放着苍白的光晕。
“魔法物品！”哈维也注意到了灰色石坠的异状，脸色顿时变得十分难看。
魔法物品可是极其罕见的东西，传闻每一件都有十分强大的威能。
哪怕是最弱的微光级魔法物品，也有着能轻松击杀一个黑铁阶的恐怖威力，抑或同等强度的防御力。
“不用担心。”安东面色平静地提醒了一句，“那只是一件次魔法物品，防御效果嘛，大概可以抵挡黑铁下游水准的十次全力一击。”
卡修斯面色微变，冷冷瞪了安东一眼。
哈维看在眼里，哪还不知道安东说的是真的，顿时松了口气，朝同伴使了个眼色，四人无声散开，呈扇形包围上去。
他们这支队伍虽然只有他一个黑铁下游，但另外三人也都有着白位上游的实力，加上常年配合，默契十足，只要对方手上没有真正的魔法物品，就算是黑铁中游，他们也有信心获胜。

卡修斯冷笑一声，探手入袍，不知道从哪里抽出一柄寒光熠熠的长剑，显然早有准备。
“就算不靠灰石项链，解决你们也费不了多少工夫。”
“本来还想再往丘陵里面走一段路程才动手，方便处理尸体，不过算了，在这里举行仪式也不错......”
话音未落，哈维四人已如离弦之箭般扑上。
哈维正面突进，两个同伴从左右包抄，维吉尔退至后方，短弩平举，弩箭的寒芒锁定卡修斯周身要害。
短短一瞬，默契尽显。
可惜他们面对的根本不是靠默契就能击败的存在。
仅仅一个照面，哈维就被劈飞出去，另外两人要不是闪躲得快，脑袋都得被凌厉的剑光削掉半个。
笃！
弩弦震动的闷声陡然响起，一抹寒光精准命中卡修斯胸口。
可不等维吉尔脸上露出喜色，就骇然看到卡修斯若无其事地拔掉身上的弩箭，随后扯掉碍事的长袍，露出赤裸的上半身。
火光摇曳，将那具躯体切割成明暗交错的诡异图景。
胸膛下半截、腰腹、双肩乃至双臂的上半截，肤色灰白如陈年蜡像，东一块西一块的紫黑尸斑如同霉斑般蔓延，而胸口以上，却仍保持着活人的红润，形成触目惊心的分界线。
这根本不像是活人该有的样子，倒更像是一头亡灵。
“亡灵化？不，不对，好像只亡灵化了一半。”
content_en:
"So you tricked them into Qianyan Hills to use them as consumables for the death ceremony."
Anton did not continue to argue with Cassius, but lightly pierced another layer of window paper.
"...it seems like you really know our organization well."
Cassius's eyes changed when he looked at Anton, fear mixed with surprise.
Even the secret death ceremony that is the core of the organization is known. If Anton could not sense the existence of the token on his body, he would almost think that the other party is also a member of the organization.
On the other side, as Cassius finished speaking, the four Harveys suddenly stood up, grabbed their weapons, and stared at Cassius with shocked and angry expressions.
"No wonder the reward you proposed is so generous. It turns out you have evil intentions!"
"Despicable guy!"
"Greed is the original sin of life and the filth of the soul." Cassius glanced at the four people indifferently, and read out the verdict in a flat tone, "Don't worry, you will be purified soon, and return to eternal tranquility in the name of death."
"Purify your mother!"
A hot-tempered young man named Star in the team could no longer bear it. He raised his short ax and struck Cassius hard on the head.
However, the ax blade was blocked by a layer of faint light about ten centimeters away from Cassius's head.
Anton's eyes fell on Cassius's chest, where the gray stone pendant was blooming with a pale halo.
"Magic item!" Harvey also noticed the strange appearance of the gray stone pendant, and his expression suddenly became very ugly.
Magic items are extremely rare, and each item is rumored to have very powerful powers.
Even the weakest low-light magic item has the terrifying power to easily kill a black iron level, or the same strength of defense.
"Don't worry." Anton reminded him calmly, "It's just a magic item. It has a defensive effect. It can probably withstand ten full blows at the level of Black Iron's lower reaches."
Cassius's expression changed slightly and he gave Anton a cold look.
Harvey saw this and didn't know that what Anton said was true. He immediately breathed a sigh of relief and winked at his companion. The four of them dispersed silently and surrounded them in a fan shape.
Although he is the only one in the lower reaches of the black iron team, the other three also have the strength of the upper reaches of the white position. With their long-term cooperation, they have a tacit understanding. As long as the opponent does not have real magic items, they are confident of winning even if they are in the middle of the black iron position.
Cassius sneered, reached into his robe, and pulled out a long sword with cold light from nowhere. He was obviously prepared.
"Even if we don't rely on the gray stone necklace, it won't take much effort to deal with you."
"I originally wanted to walk a little further into the hills to make it easier to dispose of the body, but forget it, it's good to hold the ceremony here..."
Before he could finish his words, the four Harveys pounced on him like an arrow from a string.
Harvey charged forward, with two companions outflanking him from the left and right. Virgil retreated to the rear, holding his short crossbow straight, and the cold light of the crossbow locked on Cassius's vitals.
In just a short moment, the tacit understanding was revealed.
It's a pity that what they are facing cannot be defeated by tacit understanding.
With just one encounter, Harvey was sent flying. If the other two people hadn't dodged quickly, half of their heads would have been cut off by the sharp sword light.
Benedict!
The muffled sound of the crossbow string vibrating suddenly sounded, and a ray of cold light accurately hit Cassius's chest.
But before Virgil's face showed joy, he was shocked to see Cassius unplugging the crossbow as if nothing had happened, then tearing off the obstructive robe, revealing his naked upper body.
The firelight flickered, cutting the body into a strange scene of light and dark.
The lower half of the chest, waist and abdomen, shoulders and even the upper half of the arms were as gray as an old wax statue, with purple-black corpse spots here and there spreading like mold spots, but above the chest, they still maintained the ruddy color of a living person, forming a shocking dividing line.
This doesn't feel like life at allWhat a human should look like is more like an undead spirit.
"Undead? No, no, it seems to be only half undead."
